I cleared the Punjab Police Sub Inspector exam with Rank 2 (713/800). Senior Assistant is the Group-B office post most clerks aim for - better pay, the same kind of general paper. This page puts the official advertisement and exam plan side by side.

The latest round is PSSSB Advertisement No. 06 of 2026 (published 7 March 2026, applications 7 to 28 March 2026). The board makes one common merit list and fills Senior Assistant demands that departments send up to 30 September 2026.

Latest notification (Advt 06/2026)

  • Post: Senior Assistant, Group-B, in various departments of the Punjab Government.
  • Posts: decided by department demands received up to 30 September 2026; a category with no demand by then gets no post from this list.
  • Applications: online at sssb.punjab.gov.in, 7 to 28 March 2026 (fee by the same date).
  • Earlier rounds: Advt 05/2023 and Advt 05/2025, both with published exam plans.

Straight answers

Frequently asked questions

What is the latest PSSSB Senior Assistant advertisement?

Advertisement No. 06 of 2026, published on 7 March 2026, with online applications from 7 to 28 March 2026. Posts are filled from one common merit list against department demands received up to 30 September 2026.

What is the PSSSB Senior Assistant salary?

Rs 35,400 at Pay Level-6, as stated in Advertisement No. 06 of 2026.

What is the Senior Assistant exam pattern?

In the official plans for Advt 05/2023 and 05/2025 - one objective paper of 120 questions, 120 marks, 2 hours, on GK, Punjab history and culture, reasoning, Punjabi, English and computers, with 1/4 mark cut for each wrong answer.

Is there a typing test?

Yes. Candidates called after the written test take a qualifying typing test at 30 words per minute in English and Punjabi on computer; Punjabi is typed in the Raavi font.

What is the age limit?

18 to 37 years as on 1 January 2026 for General candidates, up to 42 for SC and BC of Punjab, up to 45 for government employees, up to 47 for persons with disabilities of Punjab, and up to 40 for widows and divorcees.
